reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 80,000.0. That is 1,051 points under spot, 1.76 hourly ATRs on a 597.41 reading, and it sits beneath the 80,213.47 15m EMA20 and under the 80,750 shelf where 3,723,243 USD of forced orders already cleared during today's pullback. A settled hourly close through it says the short squeeze that produced this move has stopped paying and the buyers who chased 81,000 are underwater.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 81,500.0. liquidityMagnet.note: Pull is up on positioning, not on the realized tape. The realized numbers are lopsided the other way by construction - 34,075,543 USD of shorts liquidated against 1,823,984 USD of longs over 6.23 hours - which is backward-looking evidence that the squeeze already happened. What makes the magnet forward-looking is the OKX long/short ACCOUNT ratio, which collapsed 1.20 to 0.90 across the last six hourly prints (1.20, 1.14, 1.05, 0.98, 0.91, 0.90). It was 1.24 and crowded-long at the morning run. Shorts are now the crowded side and the 81,250 bucket is where they die. Nearest below is 81,000 at 51 points, a thin 2.26m shelf; the real downside magnet is 79,750 at 4,582,053 USD, which is why the stop reference and the invalidation are set far apart.

liquidations.note: 2,499 unique filled OKX BTC-USDT-SWAP liquidations across 6.23 hours to 2026-09-03T17:46:51Z, newest fill 0 seconds old at 81,135.4; contract size 0.01 BTC. Shorts 34,075,543 USD against longs 1,823,984 - an 18.7-to-1 ratio, and effectively ALL of it inside the last six hours. For scale, the morning report measured 3,883,101 of short liquidation over a 23.78-hour window; this run measured nearly nine times that in a quarter of the time. skew is the OKX long/short ACCOUNT ratio at 0.90 on the 17:00 UTC bar, down from 1.24 at the morning run, with 1.20, 1.14, 1.05, 0.98, 0.91, 0.90 across the last six hourly prints - a clean, monotonic flip from crowded-long to crowded-short. Open interest rose 149,588,797 USD to 2,391,511,884 and funding FELL to +0.0000462290754657 for the 22:00 UTC settlement from +0.0000608482772682 at the morning read, with the perp premium NEGATIVE at -0.0004314018511473. Longs paying less and the perp trading at a discount while price adds 4 percent is the signature of a SPOT-led advance that forced shorts to cover, not a leveraged long stampede. That is the higher-quality version of this move and it is the main reason confidence is 6.5 rather than 5.

calibration.rollingRecord: Settled-close gates 6 for 6 this week; the discretionary overlay on top of them 0 for 4.
calibration.note: The morning add gate at 78,240.0 armed and paid: price is 2,811 points above it and the low since the morning snapshot was 77,936.9, so the 77,470.0 reduce gate was never approached - 466.9 points of clearance at the worst point. That is the sixth consecutive settled-close gate to be correct. actingHelped is FALSE, and this is the important entry. The morning session, holding a correct bullish-tilt read, trimmed 5 percent of the spot core at 77,973.1 on decaying momentum and a crowded-long account ratio, five hours thirty-seven minutes before a 3.95 percent advance. Every input behind that trim was accurate and the conclusion was still wrong, because a crowded-long ratio at 1.24 was read as exhaustion when it was the setup for the flip to 0.90 that squeezed the tape higher. The rule this costs: momentum decay inside an intact uptrend is not a reason to sell the core, only a reason not to add to it.
